name: Sunlight
body:
School evocation [light]; Level bard 5, cleric 5, druid 5, hunter 5, inquisitor 5, oracle 5, paladin 4, shaman 5, warpriest 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target object touched
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell works as daylight, except the spell counts as natural sunlight for the purpose of creatures and effects affected by it.
